# Audit FP pattern: re.Pattern.search / compiled regex .search on PDF bytes is not LDAP.
lang: python
file: CWE-90-regex-search-safe.py
---
import re
from typing import Optional

_PAGE_COUNT_RE = re.compile(rb"/Type\s*/Pages\b.*?/Count\s+(\d+)", re.S)


def _page_count(data: bytes) -> Optional[int]:
    match = _PAGE_COUNT_RE.search(data)
    return int(match.group(1)) if match is not None else None


def trailer_match(data: bytes):
    return re.search(rb"trailer\b", data)
